div.div: تَرِكَةٌ A thing that is left, forsaken, relinquished, abandoned, deserted, or quitted; like طَلِبَةٌ meaning “ a thing desired, or sought; ” (TA;) see also تَرْكَةٌ: particularly, the inheritance, or property that is left, of a person deceased; (S, Msb, K; *) also pronounced ↓ تِرْكَةٌ : pl. تَرِكَاتٌ. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
